newsitem.title: TURKEY: One soldier dead in Turkish landmine blast.
newsitem.headline: One soldier dead in Turkish landmine blast.

text.p: One soldier was killed on Wednesday when a military vehicle hit a landmine in the southeastern Turkish province of Batman, security officials said.
State-run Anatolian news agency said that three soldiers were also injured in the explosion.
The security officials, who did not give any information on wounded, said the mine was planted by Kurdish rebels on a road often used for delivering food to gendarme posts in Batman province.

More than 21,000 people have died in the 12-year armed struggle between the Turkish security forces and rebels of the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK), fighting for Kurdish autonomy or independence in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
